slots.title: Tether: Senator's investigation misses positive work that's led to lower Iran volumes
slots.author: CoinDesk
slots.summary: The stablecoin issuer's CEO, Paolo Ardoino, has been defending against accusations that the firm's stablecoins have fueled financial activity in Iran.

slots.title: U.S. CFTC rebuffs CME legal stance in consequential fight over perpetual futures
slots.author: CoinDesk
slots.summary: The future of perps in the U.S. may be at stake as the CFTC argues that CME hasn't shown the new policy is hurting it after the agency OK'd its first bitcoin perp.

slots.title: Amazon is taking its biggest shot at Nvidia yet with new TorchNeuron dev tool
slots.author: TechCrunch
slots.summary: Amazon wants to break Nvidia’s hold on PyTorch, the free toolkit used to build most AI apps, so that more developers run their apps on alternative chips like its own.

slots.title: Tolan snags $30M for its AI companion that helps users navigate life
slots.author: TechCrunch
slots.summary: AI companion app Tolan has raised another $30 million after attracting more than 250,000 active users.

slots.title: Hackers hit AI coding tool OpenCode, running up charges on users’ AI accounts
slots.author: TechCrunch
slots.summary: OpenCode is an open-source AI coding agent that's become a popular alternative to Claude Code and Cursor. But hackers got into part of its online platform and stole some users’ API keys, and the AI tools it turned to for help kept refusing to look at the malicious code.

slots.author: TechCrunch
slots.summary: Eugenia Kuyda's newest startup Wabi is positioned to take advantage of an idea she had more than a decade ago. Wabi offers a personal AI assistant with a twist, free and downloadable to anyone today.
